axis_supply.supply_status: CRITICAL - Division besieged at Bardia fortress since mid-December 1940. Supply lines from Tripoli completely severed (1,800+ km). Fuel reserves exhausted by January 3rd - vehicles immobilized. Ammunition critically low - artillery rationed to defensive fires only, small arms ammunition down to 15-20 rounds per rifle. Water from Bardia wells adequate but under British fire. Food supplies critically low (3-5 days remaining). Medical supplies inadequate for treating wounded. No resupply possible - fortress completely surrounded by Australian 6th Division. Supply collapse directly contributed to fortress fall. Division fighting capability severely degraded by logistics failure.
